reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Fast Tracking towards HIV & TB Epidemic Control - Zambia (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Zambia, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Zambia (MOH)This program has the following goals: Achieving zero new infections, zero HIV and AIDS related mortality and morbidity and zero discrimination. Avert 80,000 new infections by 2020. Avert 43,000 AIDS related deaths by 2020. To reduce the number of TB deaths in the population by 40% in 2021 compared to 2015. The objectives of this program are: 90% of PLHIV know their HIV status. 90% of people diagnosed with HIV enrolled on ART. 90% of PLHIV receiving ART achieve viral suppression. To reduce stigma and discrimination associated with HIV and AIDS. To improve access and utilisation of HIV and AIDS servcies by population groups most at risk

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for ZMB-C-MOHP02
Number of notified TB cases (all forms) contributed by non-national TB program providers - community referrals
Number of people who were tested for HIV and received their results during the reporting period
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of men who have sex with men reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Number of medical male circumcisions performed according to national standards
YP-0ther-1 Percentage of adolescent girls and boys and young women and men reached with HIV prevention programs- defined package of services
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of people living with HIV newly enrolled in HIV care started on TB preventive therapy
Percentage of people living with HIV currently receiving antiretroviral therapy
Proportion of facility reports received over the reports expected during the reporting period
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of HIV-positive women who received ART during pregnancy and/or labour and delivery
Impact indicators targets and results for ZMB-C-MOHP02
Estimated percentage of children newly infected with HIV from mother-to-child transmission among women living with HIV delivering in the past 12 months
Number of new HIV infections per 1000 uninfected population
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
Outcome indicators targets and results for ZMB-C-MOHP02
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Percentage of adults and children with HIV, known to be on treatment 12 months after initiation of antiretroviral therapy
